# The test suites CI does NOT run, and the measured reason for each.
#
# This file exists because of the actual defect behind #7. 65 suites had
# stopped running without anyone deciding they should; they were not excluded,
# they were simply never named anywhere, so nothing could report them missing.
# Naming them is what makes "not run" a decision with an owner instead of an
# accident nobody can see.
#
# CI runs 134 of 156 suites, up from 92 before #13 and 123 after it. The 22
# below are the remainder. Every one was measured against a real PostgreSQL 16
# with the schema pushed, individually, not in a batch:
#
#   DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/backenly_test \
#   TEST_DATABASE_URL=$DATABASE_URL DIRECT_URL=$DATABASE_URL \
#   JWT_SECRET=ci-not-a-real-secret \
#   npx jest --runTestsByPath <path> --ci --forceExit
#
# None of them are excluded for needing a database. A database is now provided
# by the `integration` job and did not fix these. Do not re-file them as
# "needs Postgres"; that was the wrong diagnosis once already.
#
# They are NOT on a blocking job because each one currently fails. ci.yml
# already carries the lesson: `tests/core` was added on a false belief that it
# was database-free, went red on every push for weeks, and a red that is always
# red carries no information. A suite joins CI when it passes, not before.

# ── Cannot run at all under the current jest setup ──────────────────────────
# Both are gated on ENGINE_MODE=runtime and skip themselves otherwise. Nothing
# can satisfy that gate: jest.setup.js line 29 assigns
# ENGINE_MODE='integration' for every suite, deliberately, so that tests never
# execute real DDL. Setting ENGINE_MODE=runtime in the environment does not
# help — the setup file runs after it and overwrites it.
#
# They are dangerous rather than merely idle. jest exits 0 on a fully skipped
# suite, so both report "pass" while running one skipped test and asserting
# nothing. They were nearly added to database-free-suites.txt on exactly that
# false green. Making them run means letting tests execute real DDL, which is
# the guard jest.setup.js exists to enforce, so it is a real decision and not
# CI wiring.
__tests__/suite1.core-integration.test.ts
__tests__/suite1.real-engine-integration.test.ts

# ── Needs a live model provider ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# Calls OpenAI for real. Cannot pass in CI without a key and a spend decision,
# and would be nondeterministic even then.
__tests__/lib/services/aiWorkspace.test.ts
tests/validation/master-capability-validation.test.ts

# ── Needs a running HTTP server ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# Black-box suites that fetch against a live app on localhost. They need the
# Next server and the Express runtime up, which no CI job currently starts.
__tests__/security/auth-security.test.ts
__tests__/security/auth-security-fixed.test.ts
__tests__/security/oauth-security.test.ts

# ── Genuine failures against a real database ────────────────────────────────
# These connect fine and then fail on their own assertions. Each needs a person
# to decide whether the test or the code is wrong. Two are worth singling out:
#
#   concurrency-convergence  9 of 10 concurrent mutations succeed where the
#                            suite demands 10. This suite exists to prove no
#                            mutation is lost under contention, so if the
#                            assertion is right this is a real lost-mutation
#                            bug in the retry path, not a flaky test. Unverified
#                            either way: measured on one machine, once.
#
#   monitoring               expects 10, receives a different count from
#                            ApiRequestLog aggregation.
#
__tests__/concurrency-convergence.test.ts
__tests__/deterministic-executor.test.ts
__tests__/invariants/mutation-safety.test.ts
__tests__/lib/services/databaseBrain.test.ts
__tests__/lib/services/monitoring.test.ts
__tests__/load/concurrency.test.ts
__tests__/load/execution-engine-performance.test.ts
__tests__/suite2.relationships.test.ts
__tests__/suite3.conflicts.test.ts
__tests__/suite4.safety.test.ts
__tests__/suite5.advisory.test.ts
tests/error-communication.test.ts
tests/field-extraction.test.ts
tests/storage-provisioning.test.ts
tests/timeline-granularity.test.ts
